name: Melbourne Theatre Company Seat Savers
summary: Weekly $29 MTC tickets for the next seven days' shows, released on Tuesdays to concession holders including full-time students.
key: $29 tickets to a week’s worth of performances, with a valid concession card.
who: Holders of a full-time student ID, Health Care Card, Pensioner Concession Card or MEAA membership.
how: Buy online on Tuesdays between 12pm and 4pm.
Collect 45 minutes before the show with one concession ID per ticket.
catches: Maximum two tickets per date per production.
Excludes Opening Nights and Special Events; no exchanges.
